results.title: National Cyber League (NCL) Fall 2026 Season
results.eligibility_notes: Open to enrolled US/Canadian postsecondary students (college included). Persona is a US-citizen junior CS undergrad -> explicitly qualifies as a Student Player. $45 regular / $55 late registration.
results.notes: CTF-style cyber competition; Individual Game Oct 23-25, Team Game Nov 6-8 2026. Categories (OSINT, crypto, forensics, web app sec, exploitation) match security interest. Earns employer-recognized Scouting Report.

results.title: MLH Fellowship - Open Source Track
results.eligibility_notes: 18+, proficient English, can code in >=1 language, reside in a non-embargoed country, commit 20 hrs/wk for 12 weeks. Persona: US citizen (non-embargoed), native English, Python+Git, junior -> Eligible. Open to students and non-students.
results.notes: Remote, year-round rolling cohorts (Spring/Summer/Fall). Need-based educational stipend. Contributes to real OSS projects with mentorship. CAUTION: requires 20 hrs/wk; persona listed 15 hrs/wk available - verify capacity before applying.

results.title: LFX Mentorship Program (Linux Foundation) - Security track
results.eligibility_notes: No age limit; open to students and non-students; project catalog includes Security (~10% of categories per LF docs). Persona (US citizen, CS junior, Python/Linux/Git) fits. Specific security-project slot availability and next application window not confirmed on the JS-rendered page.
results.notes: Three terms/year; stipend varies by project. Security-relevant projects (OpenSSF, Sigstore, etc.) align with interests. Live open projects listed on the mentorship platform - check there for current Security openings.

results.title: CyberCorps: Scholarship for Service (SFS)
results.organization: NSF / U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM)
results.eligibility_notes: Must be US citizen/PR, full-time student at a PARTICIPATING school, junior/senior with >=2 years remaining, GPA 3.0+, and agree to post-grad federal cybersecurity service. Persona: US citizen, junior, grad 2028-05 (>=2 yrs), CS -> likely qualifies EXCEPT school participation is unknown (no school in profile).
results.notes: Full tuition + $27k/yr undergrad stipend + $6k pro dev. Deadlines are school-specific (e.g. WSU Nov 1 2026 for Spring 2027; many schools Feb-Apr 2027). Confirm your school runs an SFS program, then apply there.

results.title: NSF REU Site: Frontier Technologies in Biometrics and Authentication (2027 Cohort)
results.eligibility_notes: US Citizen/PR, basic programming (Python/Java/C/C++ etc), preferred GPA 3.0+, engineering/science major. Persona: US citizen, CS junior, Python -> Eligible. On-site Buffalo, 10 weeks.
results.notes: Summer 2027 (May 29-Aug 6); >=$5k stipend + housing. Cybersecurity-adjacent (authentication/biometrics). Fits the 2027-06~08 summer availability window. On-site, not remote.

results.title: REU Site: Multi-disciplinary Research with the FABRIC Network (Summer 2027)
results.eligibility_notes: Targeted at undergraduate students; NSF REU generally requires US citizen/PR. Persona (US citizen, junior CS) likely qualifies. Exact 2027 dates not yet posted - page says 'visit our site in January' (2026 cycle closed Apr 10).
results.notes: Research at the intersection of networking, distributed systems, ML and cybersecurity (ML-driven security, P4/FPGA). 9 weeks. Applications expected to open ~Jan 2027; check back then.

results.title: OpenSSF Mentorship Program (security-focused open source)
results.eligibility_notes: Open to students; security-focused OSS mentorship (projects gittuf, rstuf, SBOMit, Minder). Persona fits. 2027 cycle dates not yet posted on any official page - discovery came from a podcast recap of the 2026 cycle.
results.notes: 2026 cycle closed (apps Apr 12 2026); next paid cycle dates TBD. Strong security+open_source fit - monitor the LFX mentorship platform in early 2027. Listed as explore given unconfirmed 2027 window.
